name: successor
definition: Subject replaces the issuer's identity (key rotation).
data-schema: successor-data = { ? reason: tstr, * tstr => any }   ; issuer is the old identity
title: Successor
description: Signed by the old identity, naming the new identity as subject. A verifier MAY follow exactly one hop of succession when no attestation of the old identity satisfies a rule for a signer that is the subject of a valid successor attestation. A second hop MUST NOT be followed and monitors SHOULD alert on it.
subject: Agent ID of the new identity
attestation-schema:
attestation = {
  subject: agent-id,
  issuer: agent-id,                      ; MUST equal the envelope signer
  claim: uri,
  data: { * tstr => any },
  ? evidence: bstr .size 32,
  ? evidence-uri: uri,
  id: bstr .size 16,
}
agent-id = bstr .size 32
uri = tstr
data-checked-by: The optional succession rule at step 9.
lifetime: 30 to 180 days by default, 400 days at most
